goals.objective: 작성한 포스트가 모두 표시되지 않고 2개만 고정되서 표시되고 있다. 모든 글이 표시되도록 수정한다. 개발 서버 실행 시 .next/dev/lock 때문에 next dev 중복 실행 오류가 발생하므로 현재 락/프로세스 상태를 정리하고 재발 방지 또는 안내 가능한 상태로 해결한다. TDD로 포스트 목록 표시 문제를 RED→GREEN으로 증명하고, 실제 브라우저/HTTP QA로 검증한다.

successCriteria.scenario: HTTP call: curl.exe -i http://localhost:3001/posts returns 200 and page HTML contains all current published post links /geul/anxiety, /geul/90, /geul/ai.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: HTTP /posts 200 and browser found postLinks ['/geul/anxiety','/geul/90','/geul/ai']; artifacts: .omo/ulw-loop/019e957f-e8a7-7ba1-87ea-a67ac91bf642/evidence/manual-http-posts.txt, manual-browser-posts.txt, manual-browser-posts.png | cleanup: QA dev server later stopped in manual-dev-cleanup.json; browse chain completed

successCriteria.scenario: TDD edge/regression: npx vitest run src/lib/geul/__tests__/server-posts.test.ts proves Firestore geul list queries do not apply arbitrary limit and author list includes legacy authorUid documents.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: RED artifacts: red-server-posts.txt showed limit(50)/limit(20) failures, red-server-posts-author-filter.txt showed authorUid filter failure. GREEN artifact: green-geul-posts-tests.txt passed 2 files 5 tests; full-vitest.txt passed 14 files 51 tests | cleanup: no runtime resources spawned by Vitest

successCriteria.scenario: Process QA: clean stale dev-portfolio Next dev process tree, remove stale .next/dev/lock only after no matching process remains, then run npm run dev -- -p 3001 and observe Ready without lock error; cleanup removes QA server and lock.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: dev-lock-cleanup.json stopped stale PIDs and removed lock; manual-dev-start.json shows Ready true without lock error; manual-dev-cleanup.json stopped QA PIDs [36064,34212,33220,17192], remaining null, lockExists false | cleanup: no dev-portfolio next dev process remains, lockExists false, no LISTEN on 3001
